Decision which data structure to use is usually crucial. Please notice that when you construct you graph, you use the [`contains` method of `LinkedList`](https://github.com/TheAlgorithms/Java/blob/a7f3fcdcf3669c4205ec65f5626b7b885993e289/src/main/java/com/thealgorithms/datastructures/graphs/WelshPowell.java#L30) which is `O(n)`. On the other hand, in the in the _main part_ of the algorithm, you just iterate though the `LinkedList`, which is fine.

For me, storing the adjacency list of a single node in a `HashSet` seems to be natural (no duplicates, constant access time, easy iteration).

Please let me know when you are ready for next _review iteration_ or when you will have some questions.
